balls.text: Mishra may drop 'em, but don't bet on David Warner dropping anything! Badri goes for his stock shot again, waiting well back to get under the full length ball and get it over long on, just that he did not time it well enough and it went straight to Warner on the long on fence.

Mishra has made another blunder in the outfield and incredibly, again he's conceded four! Badri got it high into the midwicket area where Mishra was running across from square leg. He got under it and put it down inexplicably, and it found a way past the rope.
nicely hit by Badri, staying back, lofting over mid on, but can't beat Warner who is prowling in the deep
good yorked on leg, Bolly can't do much except squeeze it down to mid on
very short, and Bolly swat-pulls it well in the end, in the air behind square to the fence.
Badri tries to get cheeky, goes outside off and tries to lap it to the leg side, but it is not fine enough to beat short fine leg
another run-out chance gone abegging. Badri hit straight to mid on and ran for the strike. The fielder misses, Badri survives and CSK have three figures
Badri makes good connection this time. Stays well back in the crease, picks up the length offering and lofts it over mid on with all his might. It lands just inside the ropes
short and marginally wide outside off, called a wide for height
direct hit would have had Bollinger's number. Straight and fast, he gets bat on it to the off side and goes for a nothing run, Nannes runs to the off side, picks up and throws... and misses
bizarre. High full toss on leg, Badri goes for a hoick over fine leg, and gets a thick top edge that somehow goes down to third man where he is caught. But it was too high and is called a no ball.
play and a miss. Badri backs away to create room to open the face and run it down through the off side, it was just outside off short of a length. He could not connect
classy yorker, tailing in on Bollinger's legs, he somehow squeezes it down towards square leg
full on his pads, Badri gets it away behind square on the leg side

Wallop! Bollinger releases the shackles on Chepauk's collective throat, with a nice lofted drive over long off. Picked the offie early, got to the pitch and went through with the shot. Finally CSK have hit a six
Badri tries to get one, drives in the air to deep midwicket on the bounce
on off and middle, Bolly stays back and pulls away to the deep
opens up the off side and goes inside out over wide mid off
gets down the track, and drives from outside off to long on to give it to Badri
offie this time, and Bolly is as befuddled as he was by the googlies, misses the swipe to leg again
full outside off, Badri gets forward and tries to drive but it takes the inside edge on to his pad
Bolly backs away to the leg side to create room, it is the leggie this time, driven to long off
another one, Bolly's not picking them at all.
again, too much turn on the googly and it misses off stump as a result.
nothing. Nice googly, spins away and misses his swipe to leg
no ball, Chennai will take that. What can Bolly do with the free hit coming up

another sweep attempted by Balaji, and with as much lack of conviction as he has displayed  all day while sweeping. Full on middle, pitches and strikes him flush in front of middle and off. Fair call.
full outside off, driven back to Mishra.
worked away off back foot to midwicket
gets it down to long on, after coming down the track
full on leg, played to the leg side for a single
finally gets a run, to retain strike
Dropped by Karthik. Under-edged the short ball and it hurried to DK who could npot grab it. Tough chance.
Bala has no clue what's happening. Goes for a random sweep and misses
appeal this time for lbw, but Balaji was well forward to the googly and the umpire said "No."

Direct hit from wide long on and Ashwin is run out trying the second run Great throw from Mishra running back towards long on, Ashwin was not expecting trouble and was not running at full tilt. Might have just proved to be his undoing, he was short by a foot at least.
Ashwin jumps out and flicks straight to short midwicket. This match has 'turned'. Well done Veerubhai.
huge turn, Badri was looking to run it down to third man and had no room to do so.
bunts it down to long on for another single
well outside off, gets forward and opens the face to get it down behind point
good running, gets inside the line and works it with the turn to fine leg and runs like the wind
gets well back and works it away to midwicket
works it away to the leg side this time to get a single. Tough times for CSK. Can't slog, it is tough just surviving out there, no wickets in hand, and no runs either.
gets forward and drives, perilously in the air, but it is down before it gets to Mishra
did he nick it? Misses the cut, and it goes into DK's gloves who appeals twice. There was some sound
pulls out the square drive again, and gets it nicely down to the sweeper
length ball turning away, gets back and works it down to long on
gets well inside the line to work it from off and middle, very fine towards fine leg. Sehwag's bowling a great spell
again down the track but the intent is just for one and he cant even get that
off the back foot this time, works it away to the same fielder
tall Ashwin hops out and gets to the pitch, but drives straight to midwicket
gets it down to long on this time for one
flighted outside off, Badri gets forward and defends. Good Test match text-book stuff
back foot punch from outside off, to deep cover to get the single
outside off, gets forward and lets it go
slightly fuller, but he stays back and tries to work it to the leg side
nicely played, big spin again, Badri waits on the backfoot and cuts through the gap behind point
wrong 'un that bounces up as well, Ashwin gets forward and fends it to the leg side
spin for Mishra as well, as expected, turns away from Badri who gets back and drives to cover

Is that Sehwag or Muralitharan?! Big spin again, from leg towards off, Morkel is befuddled completely as it takes outside edge and carries to Collingwood at slip who takes it cleanly. Chennai are shell-shocked, both the team and the city!
flighter on off, Badri gets forward and drives to long on
finds the gap this time, gets forward and drives to deep cover
turn for Sehwag, sqaures him up as it spins from leg to off, gets an outside edge to the off side
full outside Albie's off stump, stays back and guides to point

well, Chennai are falling apart in bizarre fashion. Flighted on Hussey's off stump, he gets forward and is early into the shot, probably eager to smother the spin. The drives pops up straight to cover. Total damage.
finally gets it away to deep cover for a single
another short one, goes for the cut and misses
shorter outside off, gets back and cuts straight to cover
gets forward and drives to Dilshan
full outside off, Hussey front-foot drives straight to mid off
as soft as they come! Raina jumps out, looks to drive inside out over cover. Everything is right about the shot, except there was a gleeful fielder at deep cover to take the offering.
defends this one down the track to Sehwag. Beaten 3 times out of 6 and yet he has 8 runs off the over
slightly shorter, Hussey gets back and taps it to mid off
fullish on leg stump and striaghtening, hits the pads but not given
another fortunate four! Hussey was drawn out and beaten by the spin, the outside edge went fine and bear short third man
drift and turn, nicely done. Hussey is beaten all ends up as it turns away
slow looper outside off, Hussey drives through square, and Mishra makes a mess of an easy pick up and throw, to concede four
gets forward and chips it nicely in the air, over the bowlers ad into no man's land. Hussey is easily back for two
drifts on Hussey's pads, he works away to midwicket
skips out and drives from leg to long off
tight line, and flighted again on off, Raina deflects to point and decides not to run
similar ball, Raina gets forward and defends
flighted outside off, driven to deep cover
delicately done. Opens the face and deflects the short of length ball on off stump to third man to retain strike
slower ball, 113.8 kph short of a length outside off, Raina stays back and works it away with the wrists to mid on
Raina backs away towards the leg side to create room through the off but cannot connect. Unnecessary ugly shot
straightens the line, and keeps the length short of driving range too. Raina defends down to Nehra
not much pace off Nehra's hand, but the pace off Raina's bat remains. Hit straight to cover off the back foot
Hussey is away, full and drifts on to his pads and he works it away nicely. Good running
counter-punched in style! 146 kph at good pace and short of good length, Raina somehow muscled the pull over mid on and the ball reached the boundary in a trice. Hands, eyes and timing!
140 kph this time, short and Raina picked it, but could not get the placement. Pulled straight to square leg
serious pace, but too short. 143 odd kph and it takes off over Raina and Karthik
through him at good pace, 145.6 kph and short of a length, Raina attempts a meek swivel pull and misses
straighter from Umesh, angling in from leg to middle, Raina gets into it and defends to the leg side
shortens the length and Raina plays it away more watchfully to the off side
in the middle of the clutter, Raina plays a shot for the ages! Full and angling across, Raina gets forward, gets down on one knee and karate chops it through the covers, high elbow and all. Wah!
length ball, on off stump, Hussey comes forward and defends to the offside. 23/3 after 4. Advantage well and truly with the Daredevils.
on Mr. Cricket's off stump, he stays back and defends to point. Chennai need this man today, desperately, to come to the party

Bouncer does the trick once again for Delhi! And another good one too - Nehra got the line just outside off and the length perfect, Vijay was committed into the pull, without being in any position to execute it. The top edge loops up and lands in Dinesh Karthik's gloves. Chepauk is queit!
intentional! Despite the presence of a slip, Vijay was looking to open the face of the bat outside off, the ball flew away off the meat, very fine to the third man fence
again short of a length, but sliding down to leg, Raina clips it down behind square
ooh, short of a length and Raina plays it a little awkwardly, he was expecting a bouncer. Keeps it away it the end off the back foot
length ball, angles in to Raina's leg stump, he rises on his toes and tucks it away to midwicket for one
the line is marginally off target this time, and it is enough for Vijay to time it away off the hips to midwicket. Good running gets three easily
great lines again, at reasonable pace too, 141 kph, length outside Vijay's off stump, he defends it to the off side
superb yorker first up, Raina digs it out to the leg side and scampers across

GONE! Nannes has got Dhoni with a short ball and Chennai are reeling here! Nice bouncer from Nannes, Dhoni was not sure which way to move, got back late and played a wimp of a pull shot, which popped up easily for Manhas at square leg inside the circle. The experiment to move to three has back-fired. Captain gone for a duck
full in length, on Dhoni's middle and leg stump, he defends to point
finishes off with another dot - good over from Nehra. Outside Vijay's off stump, he stays back and blocks down the track

form may be temporary, but while it lasts it is a great thing for Vijay! That was not a short ball by any stretch of imagination, Vijay picked the length early and pulled it really well, really fine. He must have seen it even before it came out of Nehra's hand!
another good ball, angling across Vijay who has nothing to do with it. Gets back and shoulders arms

Collingwood shows how it is done! Hayden's poor IPL continues, he walked down the pitch this time, expecting to get to the pitch, but Nehra shortened the length, Hayden went through with the straight drive and spooned it straight up over cover. Colly runs back and takes it easy. Big wicket, Hayden murdered them the last time.
and again, good line and length from over the sticks. Nehra puts it back of a length and shapes it away nicely
nice away movement from Haydos, he shoulders arms
nicely played, not timed as well as the previous one. Over-pitched outside off, Vijay gets forward and drives along the carpet through the covers.
full toss on Vijay's pads and he is in too good form to not cash in. Stays back and flicks it with minimum fuss through midwicket - mid on gap. Nicely played.
length ball on Vijay's middle stump, handled with care
good short ball, Vijay gets back and blocks

Dropped by Gambhir! Hayden is on a pair of sorts, having got out for a blob in the previous game, he is early into the shot, off a full toss and the drive pops straight up over the bowler's head. Gambhir and Mishra converge from mid on and mid off, and there is no calling. Gambhir gets there, they run across each other, but he fluffs it. Communication would have helped, would have been a sitter for either player.
on Hayden's pads, he flicks straight to Warner at midwicket who attempts to throw down the non-striker's stumps. No harm done.
ah, radar is not yet turned on, Nannes slips down the leg, Karthik makes a diving half-stop to restrict it to two wides
and Gauti finishes it off the way he set it up.Chips it over midwicket and runs through for two, with beads of sweat dripping all over the pitch from his forehead.
cuts away the slower ball, in the air but safely over point. Two to win
driven straight to Haydos at cover, who fumbles and recovers. Dot.
back of a length outside off and Gauti can't work it away
full and wide outside off, Manhas can't connect with his swing. 4 to win off 12.
full on offstump, tapped to third man for a single.
Fifty to Gautam Gamhir! Picked the short of length ball and pulled it between mid on and midwicket for four. An innings worth its weight in unobtainium!
backs away and works it down from outside off to third man
full pitched on middle and leg, driven straight to mid on
full toss from Bolly, Gambhir pulls it away, not enough muscle left on him to get that to the fence, but he runs through for three
keeps a little low, still manages to cut it away to point
short again, and he rocks back to cut it away, he's done this all day
up and over, inside out, over the head of cover fielder and through for four! Delhi are winning this, and their captain deserves all the credit.
Gautam Gambhir, take a bow! He has kept his cool under pressure, ticking the singles and now he's turning it on. Picked the short ball and pulled it again nicely to midwicket
cut away from middle and leg towards the sweeper
and another four, you can feel the weight being taken off the pressure cooker by these two! Marginally short, he latched on to it like a limpet and pulled it in front of square. See you later!
looking to cut off the stumps, goes straight to point
works it away to to square leg to give it to Gauti
super stroke under pressure! Manhas keeps his cool and pulls out a nice controlled sweep over midwicket for a rare boundary
short outside off, and it climbed after bouncing. Pulled down to midwicket
pulls it away this time to midwicket. Raina has figures of 2-0-5-0. CSK need wickets though. If these two bat through I suspect DD will win.
and again. No Karbonn Kamaal, but that was a carbon copy of the previous ball
short again, on leg and middle, Gambhir makes room and cuts straight to cover
sliding on to the pads, worked away to midwicket
short, slow and just wide outside off, Gambhir cuts away to the sweeper. He is playing a gem here.
worked away from middle and off to long on
whipped from middle and off to midwicket for another single
he comes down this time to smother the turn and plays to mid on, for no run
good ball, on middle and leg straightening away from the batsman. Defended
on Gambhir's pads, he is down the track and tips it to long on.
finds the gap this time, between cover and mid off
full blooded cover drive, straight to cover
square driven straight to point. Poor over from Bala, it has released the pressure. CSK need to strike. Gauti has done well, Manhas is giving him good company
outside off, he waits for it and square drives to the sweeper
opens the face and runs it into the ground and it bounces high over short third man
loses the plot completely and utterly. Horribly short and wide down the leg, that could have been wide on two counts, five wides that too.
hurries him this time with some extra pace, Gambhir misses
short again, Manhas pulls this time straight to square leg
crucial four, well done Manhas! Short and just outside off from Bala andf Manhas kept his wits about him and cut it well for 4
just about manages to avert the maiden, Raina dived but it went under him to long on for a single. Great over, but CSK need wickets.
ooh, five on the trot! Misses the cut and Dhoni collects
and four now! Good bowling, keeps it tight
very good bowling, three dots. On off stump, worked straight to midiwcket
nice fielding by Raina, full on off, hit back hard towards him, he tumbles and cleans up
tight line outside off, not much turn played to point
worked away off the backfoot from off stump line to the leg side, they decide against a single as Bala pounces on it in his follow through
slow and short outside off, tip and run straight to point
outside off this time, short of a length and played straight to cover
short and wide down the leg side,
short outside off, cut away to deep cover. Not much pace from Bala, as usual
full outside off, driven nicely off the front foot where Hayden makes a brilliant diving save
short of a length angling in and worked away to square leg
ooh, perilously close to nicking the late cut, but he does not and Dhoni doesn't collect cleanly either
fuller this time, drives down to long on. And Dhoni has moved back up to the sticks
slower ball, 110.1 kph and Gambhir has no power to pull it away
again short, and tight line outside off, he stays back and works it towards cover for one
loses the plot, goes down the leg side with another bouncer
very short, Gambhir stays well back and cuts down to deep point
short outside off, Dhoni is standing back now, Manhas rises up runs it down to third man
turn and bounce, sliding down leg. Ridiculous appeal for lbw to herald the time-out.
on middle and leg, Gambhir uses the wrists to glance to square leg but no runs
full on middle and leg, driven to cover, Gambhir is walking across, he is thoroughly exhausted
armer, hurrying onto Manhas who does well to keep it out
cheeky! Plays that very late off the stumps very fine to third man and gets three for it
jumps down the reack and drives it nicely wide of long on for two. Gauti is looking the part
gets inside this one and works it to midwicket.
opens the face and runs it down on the bounce to short third man
George Bailey bails him out! Gambhir stays back and cuts it towards point boundary where Jakati from third man makes a mess of it, but not Bailey who was covering for him, having come in from cover
ooh, this time he misses but only just and it goes into Dhoni's gloves. Good take
nicely played by Gauti, Dhoni is standing up to the stumps and he works it away almost off the gloves to third man
full from Albie sliding on to his pads, he works it down to square leg to get off the mark

and he's got him this time! He's bowled three very good balls at DK and set him up, this one was quicker and not short enough for the pull. But DK thought so, he went though with the shot and top edged the pull to midwicket where Badri takes a well judged catch under pressure. That was swirling and curling in the Chennai lights, but Badri kept his cool.
turn and bounce, gets the outside edge and it goes in the air. Thankfully for DK there was only one slip, down to third man for two
nice arm ball, but DK picks it and opens the face, but can't elude point
little turn from outside off, DK looks to get forward and cover drive, can't find the gap.
down the track this time, gets to the pitch and drives down to long on
length on off stump, Gambhir works it away to midwicket and runs well
short of a length again, outside off DK looks to come down the track and drive but it is too short. Well bowled Bolly! He does not look like he can bowl four on the trot.
whipped away very nicely from outside off, he had to make all the pace on that, and he obliged, off the back foot towards midwicket. Bollinger is drained of energy
keeps it on off stump, Gauti gets forward and opens the face to run it down to third man
looks for the yorker, but is overpitched at 140 kph, Gambhir flicks it to square leg
short of a length outside off, stays back and defends to the leg side
zips past Gambhir's outside edge as he looks to cut, through to Dhoni
gets forward and tips it to the leg side for another single. These two need to keep their cool for DD. Can't afford more wickets now.
presses forward and taps it down to the leg side
whoa! Big spin, beating two batsmen-wicketkeepers all ends up, and somehow misses the stumps. Four byes
beautiful arm-ball, Gambhir, one of the best players of spin in the world, had no clue about it. Inside edged to the leg side
down the track and driven down to long on
good line and length outside off at brisk pace, Gambhir says "Respect" as he shoulders arms
gets down the track and tucks it down to midwicket
thickish outside edge again, as Gambhir stays back and looks to fend the short of length ball to third man. He picks a single
137.9kph, back of a length on off stump, Gambhir stays back and defends
Dhoni for high jump in the Olympics for India please. That was very short and went miles above the batsman's head. Dhoni somehow leapt high and pulled it down.
almost foxes him with a smart slower ball, DK did not pick it and was early into the front-foot cover drive, which goes  in the air, but in the gap
short of a length, DK plays it away quietly
lucky! Gambhir jumps out, but despite getting close to the pitch is beaten by the spin, as he looks to loft over the off side, and gets a thin outside edge that runs away to third man
fuller on leg, hits him on the pads, Ashwin and Dhoni go up just to let Gauti know who is boss.
and again, Morkel dives at point to stop the run
edges the cut this time, it goes in the air but is safe. PRESSURE!
HUGE spin, Gambhir is beaten all ends up, and somehow does not outside edge it
worked away with the spin to the leg side for a single
gets back to a short ball and tips it to square leg for a single. The Test match field - 2 slips and a leg slip - converge, but they pick one
full outside DK's off stump, square driven to point

three down before you know it! Dilshan is a goner too and Chennai are right back in this! Straight ball with a very faint hint of inward movement which Dishan did not spot. He went through with the expansive cover drive, despite not being to the pitch, got an inside edge and it crashed into the furniture. Chepauk is roaring " BOLL IN GERR!!!"
ooh, Gambhir nearly runs himself out once again. Tip and run straight to mid on, where Ashwin is slow to react and his throw is average too.
Short of a length into Gambhir who tucks it away quietly

Sehwag is gone! Chennai's Australians rise to the occasion! Full and fast outside off to Sehwag who goes for the booming square drive and gets a thick edge that would have flown over most heads at slip, but big booming Matty Hayden was there, all of six feet and several inches, jumping up and taking it overhead. Chepauk roars!
spin again, from middle to down the leg, Sehwag stays back and taps it to short fine leg
edged past slip, Sehwag went back and looked to cut, but he was bemused by the extra spin, it went off the face fine.
short into Dilshan, he gets back and pulls without much timing to the deep

Ashwin is back in business! Short of a length, but big spin from outside leg to off, Warner can't control the cut, it goes in the air to cover where Vijay dives forward and comes up with the ball, letting out a huge roar. The crowd loves it! Hang on guys, this ain't over.
full on leg stump, Warner gets forward and defends to mid on
Sehwag gets forward and lashes the ball with the spin to deep midwicket
